events.verdict: Jokic (DEN) and Marshall (DAL) briefly engage in marginal contact in the post, prior to disengaging.
Jokic (DEN) receives the ball in the lane and turns to shoot in a continuous motion towards the basket within three seconds.
Irving (DAL) establishes a legal position with both arms raised vertically, when marginal contact occurs during Jokic's (DEN) shot attempt.
Lively II (DAL) cleanly blocks Jokic's (DEN) shot attempt near the rim.
Lively II (DAL) cleanly blocks Westbrook's (DEN) shot attempt before the ball touches the backboard.
Watson (DEN) dislodges Grimes (DAL) from his rebounding position, which affects his ability to pursue the loose ball.
Jokic (DEN) places his off-arm against Grimes' (DAL) side and marginal arm to arm contact occurs as Jokic releases away during the drive.
Grimes (DAL) jumps alongside Jokic's (DEN) path and makes contact with his off-arm after the release of the driving shot attempt, which is marginal.
Washington (DAL) cleanly deflects the ball away from Jokic (DEN) during the rebound.
Murray (DEN) cleanly dislodges the ball from Irving (DAL) during his driving shot attempt.
Washington (DAL) avoids stepping out of bounds while in possession of the ball.
Murray (DEN) is last to make contact with the ball prior to it going out of bounds.

Murray (DEN) briefly places a hand on Washington's (DAL) back and marginal contact occurs prior to his hand sliding off during the driving shot attempt. The contact to Washington's right arm occurs after the release and is deemed incidental.
Washington (DAL) slightly extends his lower body into Porter Jr.'s (DEN) path and marginal contact occurs when the two players come together.
Washington (DAL) moves alongside Jokic's (DEN) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) makes clean contact with the ball as he defends Lively II (DAL) on the perimeter.
Jokic (DEN) briefly places his hand to Grimes (DAL) front before removing it and the contact that occurs on-ball is marginal.
Lively II (DAL) is in the lane for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Murray (DEN) contests the driving shot attempt and marginal contact occurs with Marshall's (DAL) arm after the release.
Kleber (DAL) commits a take foul on Westbrook (DEN).
Irving (DAL) commits a take foul on Westbrook (DEN).

Jokic (DEN) and Lively II (DAL) mutually engage in marginal arm to arm contact during the rebound. Following the arm contact, Lively II loses his balance, leans forward and Jokic's left arm makes incidental contact to Lively II's head/face.
Lively II (DAL) brings two hands to Jokic's (DEN) back while the shot attempt is airborne and marginal contact occurs. Lively II does not extend his arms to dislodge Jokic.
Westbrook (DEN) commits a take foul on Irving (DAL).
Marshall (DAL) commits a take foul on Murray (DEN).
Porter Jr. (DEN) commits a take foul on Washington (DAL).
